Most people are still typing prompts one at a time. Someone built a free directory of over 100 ready-made AI bots that run your inbox, your CRM, and your calendar on a schedule instead.

It's called Bot Directory. Every entry is a full setup prompt. Copy it, paste it once, answer https://t.co/Tg7EKIL4LV

Worth knowing before you start. These run on Grok Bot, which needs a SuperGrok Heavy or Cursor Ultra plan. The free route is Rakazo, an open-source version where you bring your own model.

Either way the prompts are locked to 1 agent product.

For prompts that run in whatever

The rest of the library is at https://t.co/QbTXyXRlOk

Follow if you'd rather run AI on a schedule than retype the same prompt every morning.
